notes.title: Meet VA Framework 12.0 - Major 2023 January Update
notes.content:
[h2]Meet Composer![/h2]

Meet the whole new low-code/no-code environment for rapidly building the knowledge-base of your bot. 

[previewyoutube=9l-CsETzK78;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://composer.oscova.com/]Test Drive Composer[/url]

Composer will enable users/developers to easily build/test and prototype the knowledge-base of their assistant without much hassle.

We have migrated created Composer Actions (Refer each plugin documentation to learn more on Actions) to supplant Workspace nodes. So you can easily migrated your Workspace projects to Composer manually.

Because Composer is a Web App, we can deploy updates immediately to our users without have to ask them to manually update their installations.

You can learn more about Composer on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SyntheticIntelligenceNetwork/playlists]YouTube Channel[/url]

[h2]Avatar Engine[/h2]

We have drastically optimized the Avatar Engine to load faster, have faster frame rate and have reduced the avatar engine disk footprint more than 50%. This should enable us to deploy updates to our users faster.

This also has reduced the app size from [b]5.08GB[/b] to [b]2.21GB.[/b]

We have also fixed a known bug that used to cause the Avatar Window to render outside the Assistant's main window.

[h3]Fullscreen Mode[/h3]

We have added the much awaited fullscreen mode. You can enable Fullscreen mode in Display plugin settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/8b5a7475d780b198b04db031b47dcbe27037dc5d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/e560cef72c0aa1d140cf456238714d04a43ae749.png[/img]

[h2]Updated VA Remote[/h2]

A new version of [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.revarn.assistant_remote_control]VA Remote[/url] with performance upgrades is now available. VA Remote enables users to send voice commands to the Assistant using their mobile connected on the same Wifi Network.

[h2]Backup plugin[/h2]

The backup plugin has now been revamped to include Assistant Settings as well. This will save users from having to re-apply all previous settings on Assistant reset or re-installation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/ef6a5547254fba73632b7efe03b1715fdea4c41f.png[/img]

[h3]Thank You![/h3]

We thank all our users for utilizing and building upon VA Framework. Your continued involvement encourages us to push forward and create better iterations of VA Framework.

Cheers!

notes.title: VA Remote app now available for free download
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/ec6e26186671af70a4a46ccd94db283fe1c356fd.png[/img]

You can now fully control and send voice commands (not just command mode but also dictation mode) directly from your Android mobile device (iOS version is in progress..) to the Assistant when connected on the same network (Wi-Fi)

Simply the scan the QR on the plugin and you will be able to download the VA Remote app directly from Google Play Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/23fa371db6c5260dd66eb098f7f66942ed20023a.png[/img]
[h3]
If you want to learn more as to how you can setup and run the app successfully follow the [url=https://developer.syn.co.in/tutorial/va/remote-control-app.html]VA Remote tutorials page [/url][/h3]

notes.title: Version 4.0 - A major update to the Avatar Engine
notes.content:
When we published the first version we had made a promise that we would work hard to improve the bundled 3D avatars. For this we had to focus on revamping the 3D Avatar Rendering Mechanism from scratch and bring in tons of new changes.

We have redesigned the avatar engine for the upcoming version and we hope our user's who put their trusts on us would enjoy it.

[h2]Female Avatar[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/29bbf4097590363332b93fa87a2e10997dc5daec.png[/img]

[h2]Male Avatar[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/aedc91ad8e1993112fe3a6d5c31ae6438226eee9.png[/img]


Apart from a new Avatar Engine the upcoming version will bring in a few other other new improvements:


[h3]DPI Aware display[/h3] 

You can now run the VA on monitors with up-to 4k resolution even with Scaling enabled on Windows settings. This was a previously known limitation with the Avatar Engine.

[h3]Opening Settings Panel[/h3]

You can now simply right click the Chat box in the Chat Panel and you'll see a new Context menu option to open the Settings Panel.

[h3]Command List[/h3]

We have taken your suggestion and we will now incorporate a new "[b]Command List[/b]" section in the offline Tutorials page as well for your reference.

[h3]Stretched Mode[/h3]

The previously experimental Dock mode has been removed for now and is replaced with a new [b]Stretched[/b] Mode. Which will make your Assistant run in a split side-by-side full display mode.

[h3]Custom Assistant Name[/h3]

You will now be able to set a custom Assistant's name. This will also affect the title of the responses generated by the Assistant.

[b]On a side note: [/b] We are trying to keep the update size to bare minimum however we believe the new update may require an additional of 2 to 3GB of HDD space for installation.

We are currently trying to push the new update within the month of April.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Discord Integration made Simple!
notes.content:
It's been an adventure releasing VA Framework on steam, and we do realize that a major chunk of our audience come from gaming background. We love games too!

As a gamer, maybe-just-maybe you use Discord? Well we thought of it and created an in-built Discord plugin so that you can talk to your VA directly from your Discord app!

We have released 2 simple video tutorials for you to learn how you can integrate your VA with Discord.

Take a look at them and let us know if you've found them helpful.

notes.title: Better Support and System Settings
notes.content:
We've upgraded the [b]System[/b] settings in the [b]Settings Panel[/b] to encapsulate more and useful options in case the user wants to do some reference or contact support.

We've added the following new options that will now always be available to end-users

[list]
[*] Contact Support - Get in touch with our development team directly via Email
[*] Community Lobby - Drop a quick chat message to our team.
[*] Visit Developer Center - Learn from new and comprehensive Online tutorials
[*] Quick Start Tutorials - If you've missed the Quick Start Tutorial, you can now revisit them.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38786312/7a4ff7c1189f2b0a5662ddbaeb4b7f93778b18af.png[/img]

We hope these channels will allow our users to leverage on VA Framework better and help us improve the framework down the line with [b]more follow-up updates.[/b]

As it's a unique and challenging venture to develop and improve VA Framework, we look forward to your feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: Launching on October
notes.content:
We are working hard to make sure things go fine on day one release. Although it's usually hard to please first-time users. There's a lot we have to ensure to give the first impression we yearn for.

We are at the moment trimming out any stuff that wouldn't be of any use to the currently targetted audience. From optimized graphics to auto-detection of devices and speech recognition, there's a lot on our plate, and we're pushing hard to meet the launch date.

Our focus it to deliver the best first time installation and usage experience to all users. For this we are tirelessly focussing on 

[list]
[*] Auto-configuration on installation
[*] Comprehensive "Getting Started" tutorial
[*] Video tutorials wherever applicable
[*] Better and smoother customization options. 
[*] In-built integration of the development environment
[/list]

As this is a complex application by nature. It would indeed be challenging making things easier for novice users. 

Usually the world of AI and Machine Learning Development is dominated by Engineers and Researchers but maybe just maybe if we can get things right (with frequent suggestions and feedback) it would all turn out well.

Cheers!
